topic: D.B. Cooper - the only unsolved skyjacking in US history
title: D.B. Cooper: The Only Unsolved Skyjacking in U.S. History
description: The 1971 hijacking that ended with a parachute jump into a storm and a case the FBI never closed. AI-narrated commentary, original take -- not a reupload of any source video.

beats.text: How does someone jump out of an airliner with $200,000 strapped to his chest and vanish forever?
In 1971, a passenger calling himself Dan Cooper hijacked a Boeing 727 mid-flight.
He demanded cash and parachutes, got both, then had the crew fly low toward Mexico.
beats.broll_query: stack of cash and parachute gear

beats.text: Somewhere over the Washington wilderness he opened the rear stairs and jumped into a storm.
The FBI chased the case for 45 years and hundreds of suspects -- and never closed it.
In 1980, a kid found a rotting bundle of the exact ransom bills on a riverbank -- but no body, no parachute.
Nobody knows if he survived, and that mystery is why the case still pulls people in.
